description.text: AI-written synthesis of the homepage and the fellowship page, prepared by the collecting assistant: the homepage says Boost VC leads pre-seed rounds, writes $500k checks, invests in 70+ startups a year, and describes itself as a deep-tech investor. The fellowship page says "Sometimes all you need is $50k to get started" and "Apply for our Winter Fellowship - Due Dec 1st." The $500k and $50k figures are different published lines and are not merged. Dec 1st has no year, so it is not stored as a deadline. The fellowship page's examples of people it has backed are color, not an eligibility list.

targetApplicants.text: AI-written interpretation of the two pages, prepared by the collecting assistant: the homepage addresses founders it describes as making aerospace and other deep-tech companies, and the fellowship page invites an application to a winter fellowship. Neither page publishes a closed stage list in the text that was kept. The two cheque sizes stay separate because the pages state both.

sources.title: Boost VC fellowship page — $50k and a date without a year
sources.quote:
Sometimes all you need is $50k to get started.
Boost VC Fellowship Check: we help you take the first step toward making Sci-Fi a reality. Apply for our Winter Fellowship
- Due Dec 1st

limitations: The application questions were not opened. No account was created, no terms were accepted, and nothing was submitted. Fields stay empty and Start Application stays blocked.

The fellowship page says the winter fellowship is due Dec 1st and does not give a year, a clock, or a timezone. deadlineAt and dateOnly stay empty. The homepage's $500k pre-seed checks and the fellowship page's $50k line are both quoted and are not treated as one instrument.
